description: Unit test class for the JSON parser handling acknowledgements of 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project. The class contains various tests verifying parsing correctness, error handling, and immutability of the JSON parser implementation related to acknowledgement JSON representations.

classes.name: ThingAcknowledgementJsonParserTest
classes.description: Test suite for the JSON parser handling acknowledgements in 'things'.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup; creates headers and parser instance.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON parser class is immutable.

methods.name: parseNullJsonObject
methods.description: Test for handling null input for the JSON parser.

methods.name: parseValidJsonRepresentationWithPayload
methods.description: Tests parsing of a valid JSON acknowledgement that includes a payload.

methods.name: parseValidJsonRepresentationWithoutPayload
methods.description: Tests parsing of a valid JSON acknowledgement without a payload.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutLabel
methods.description: Tests handling of missing label field in the JSON acknowledgement.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidLabel
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid label value in the JSON acknowledgement.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutEntityId
methods.description: Tests handling when the entity ID is missing.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidEntityId
methods.description: Tests handling invalid entity ID formats.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutEntityType
methods.description: Tests missing entity type field handling.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithUnexpectedEntityType
methods.description: Tests for mismatch between expected and actual entity types.

methods.description: Handling cases where status code is missing in JSON.

methods.description: Handling of unknown or unsupported status codes.
